About this blog

---
title: "About Me"
image: profile.jpg
about:
  template: jolla
---

Hi, I'm **AndyBourne** – a finance professional, MBA candidate, and a passionate researcher at the intersection of capital markets and emerging technologies.

Currently based in Sichuan, China, I work in the IPO advisory space for Hong Kong hard‑tech companies, with a focus on cornerstone investment strategies and anchor‑effect dynamics. My daily work involves hands‑on financial modeling, valuation, and deal structuring – experience I actively share on this blog.

### What I write about

- **IPO data & valuation modeling** – real‑world case studies from the HKEX pipeline.
- **AI & robotics value chains** – deep‑dive industry research on supply chains, competitive moats, and technology adoption curves.
- **Investment frameworks** – exploring the intersection of fundamental analysis, behavioral finance, and quantitative methods.

### My vision

> *“Future adaptability = AI × Robotics × Content Creation × Health.”*

I believe the next decade belongs to those who can synthesise insights across disciplines. This blog is my laboratory – a place to publish raw data, test hypotheses, and refine my thinking in public.
